title: Penny (front)
notes: Copper coin, stylized profile facing right with beard; IN GOD WE TRUST on top, LIBERTY on the left. Size to scale with the other coins (19.05 mm).

title: Penny (back)
notes: Union Shield reverse: shield with 13 stripes and E PLURIBUS UNUM on its top bar, ONE CENT scroll, UNITED STATES OF AMERICA around the top.

title: Nickel (front)
notes: Silver coin, stylized forward-facing bust (simple features, not a likeness); IN GOD WE TRUST on the left, LIBERTY on the right. 21.21 mm to scale.

title: Nickel (back)
notes: Monticello building with dome and columned portico; E PLURIBUS UNUM, FIVE CENTS, UNITED STATES OF AMERICA.

title: Dime (front)
notes: Silver coin with reeded edge, stylized profile facing left; LIBERTY on the left, IN GOD WE TRUST under the chin. 17.91 mm to scale (smallest).

title: Dime (back)
notes: Torch with an olive branch (left) and an oak branch (right); UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, E PLURIBUS UNUM, ONE DIME; reeded edge.

title: Quarter (front)
notes: Silver coin with reeded edge, stylized profile facing left with hair tied back in a ribbon; LIBERTY on top, IN GOD WE TRUST on the left. 24.26 mm: 680 px across.

title: Quarter (back)
notes: Heraldic eagle with raised wings on a bundle of arrows above olive branches; UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, E PLURIBUS UNUM, QUARTER DOLLAR; reeded edge.
